results: Excel formation opens with its four steps and a breadcrumb trail
The sidebar has the Collateral folder, open, with the two sections inside
The folder folds
The folder opens again
Only Import is available before a file is opened
The shared Dropzone is reused, with no essay about privacy
A non-xlsx file is refused with a clear message and a way to choose another or retry
A valid file waits on Import until the person chooses to see what was found, then the overview opens
The overview counts the findings the fixture was built to contain
Hidden rows are reported and still checked
The overview names problems by category, not by value (no cell text in it)
Choosing a problem opens the review filtered to it
The gallery shows a stage, a rail of specimens and the details
The issue table is the CRM data table, virtualized: far fewer rows in the DOM than issues
Search by text finds the broken cells
The stage shows the whole file: every column of the sheet fits the stage width, none is cut
The stage reads like Excel: formula bar with the cell, column letters, row numbers, sheet tab and position
The cells with findings are marked in the sheet and on the strip
Only the visible window of rows is in the DOM (virtual), not all 122
Hovering the sheet shows a round magnifier
The magnifier draws a few real cells at the larger size (no scaled copy of the sheet, so nothing is resampled)
The magnifier says where it is looking (cell and zoom)
Alt + wheel changes the magnifier zoom (2 to 8 times)
The magnifier leaves with the pointer
Suggestions are immediately actionable with no playback controls or invented performance figures
The original is readable and the suggested word has occurrence evidence
The two full-width blocks are stacked and the preview has a bounded height
The evidence disclosure explains that frequency is not accuracy
The shallow preview opens a viewer with a restrained entrance and settles at full size
The viewer is a modal dialog that focuses Close
The viewer has two ways to see the file: Whole file and Readable
The magnifier works in the viewer too, on real cells
Readable lays the columns out at a size that can be read, still the same file
Escape closes the viewer and returns focus to the stage
Arrow keys step through the issues on the stage
Right click on an issue row opens the Orbit menu with its four actions
Nothing is applied by itself: the first issue is still open
Using the reading fills the new value without approving it
Approving verifies the issue and moves on
Approved issues move to Done, including the twin column
Clicking a column head sorts the table (the rows run the other way)
An exception without a reason is refused (1 alerts: ["A reason is required"])
An exception with a reason is recorded
Bulk fixes list only exact text operations
The bulk preview shows before and after
Bulk apply closes the dialog and can be undone in one step
Progress is saved as a file named after the workbook
The progress file holds corrections and exceptions tied to the workbook by its fingerprint, and nothing else
Resuming replays every correction and the counts equal the saved ones
After resuming, the review stands exactly where it was saved
Resuming is one step: Undo takes it back
Progress from another workbook is refused and nothing changes
A file that is not progress is refused
The corrected workbook is checked before it is offered
The download is named after the original
The exported file keeps hidden rows and the filter
The exported file no longer has the approved question marks
Moving to JSON formation keeps the workbook: no file gate, the mapping lists every profile column with its JSON target
The breadcrumb follows the section and the step
The grouped preview is labelled as diagnostic
The reporting JSON is locked while serious issues remain: only the audit report can be downloaded
Going back to Excel formation finds the same file and the work done
The grouped preview lists the hierarchy
All serious issues resolved, but the metadata is still missing, so the JSON stays locked
The report date offered is the one the workbook carries
With every check green the JSON is ready
The file is named reporting-output.json
It is strict UTF-8 JSON with the metadata typed on the page
The hierarchy has 1 branch, 2 customers and 3 assets from 4 rows
TS013 holds the approved text, TS006 the exact sum and TS009 the merged contracts
Leading zeros and empty arrays survive
No review metadata is in the contractual file
The audit report holds fingerprints, decisions and counts but no cell text or contact details
Closing the file returns to an empty import and the JSON section asks for a workbook
Without a workbook the JSON section shows a gate with a way back
No request ever left this origin while the workbook was open
A reload forgets the workbook (nothing is stored)
No storage holds workbook text
No sideways scroll on the review page at 390px
On touch there is no hover: the expand button is always visible and the stage fits at 390px
The details and the guess panel stay inside the screen at 390px
No sideways scroll on the review page at 320px
On touch there is no hover: the expand button is always visible and the stage fits at 320px
The details and the guess panel stay inside the screen at 320px
Dark theme reaches the review page
No page errors
